subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 27 26 receptacle mounting height between Electrical Panel

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 27 26 receptacle mounting height between One-Line Diagram E-002 and Electrical Panel Schedule E-601 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication?
